notes: Read all 61 source lines before editing. Module is the shared dashboard 'big number' presenter (a pure presentational component); its purpose and centered value/unit/label/subtitle/badge layout are preserved in the native header comment.

Imports (L1-3): @/components/data-display AnimatedNumber (L1), @/components/ui Badge (L2), and @/lib/cn cn (L3) have no DOM in native, so all three are inlined to keep this shared component self-contained (mirroring the sibling ProjectedRangeWidget native port that inlined the same helpers). AnimatedNumber -> a local rAF count-up (ease-out quad 1-(1-p)^2 from 0 to value over duration*1000ms, fmtNumber(display, decimals) with tabular-nums, reduce-motion aware); Badge -> a local native pill backed by theme tokens; cn -> dropped (React Native has no class names) and replaced by StyleSheet styles + a dynamic {color: valueColor} override.

badgeVariantMap (L5-10): ported verbatim as a typed Record<'success'|'warning'|'error'|'neutral', BadgeVariant> with the same mappings (success->success, warning->warning, error->danger, neutral->neutral).

WidgetBigNumberProps (L12-21): ported verbatim -> value: number|null (L13), unit?: string (L14), label?: string (L15), subtitle?: string (L16), badge?: {text; variant} (L17), valueColor?: string (L18), nullDisplay?: string (L19), animated?: boolean (L20). valueColor now carries a native color string instead of a Tailwind class (web default 'text-white' -> native colors.textPrimary), documented inline. Two optional native-only props are added without breaking any web call site: locale?: string (default 'en-US') reproduces the web AnimatedNumber's @/lib/numberFormat module-global locale -- which defaults to 'en-US' and is mutated by useSettings -- without a hidden singleton, and testID?: string for native testing.

Component signature + defaults (L23-32): export function WidgetBigNumber with destructured defaults preserved -> valueColor = colors.textPrimary (web 'text-white', L29), nullDisplay = '—' (L30), animated = true (L31).

Outer container (L34): web 'flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full gap-1' -> styles.root {flex:1, alignItems:'center', justifyContent:'center', gap: spacing.xs(4)} (h-full -> flex:1 to fill a flex parent; gap-1 -> 4).
Value row (L35): web 'flex items-baseline gap-1' -> styles.row {flexDirection:'row', alignItems:'baseline', gap: spacing.xs(4)}.

Value rendering (L36-44) preserved branch-for-branch: value !== null ? (animated ? AnimatedNumber value={value} (web text-3xl font-bold + valueColor, L38) -> 30px bold tabular-nums with {color: valueColor} : non-animated raw {value} (web text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums + valueColor, L40) -> AppText weight=bold + styles.tabularNums + {color: valueColor} rendering String(value), preserving the web's raw-number (un-fmtNumber'd) output for the non-animated path) : the null branch (web text-3xl font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)], L43) -> styles.value + styles.valueNull (colors.textMuted) rendering nullDisplay.
Unit (L45): web {unit && <span text-lg text-[var(--text-secondary)]>} -> {unit ? <AppText style={styles.unit}(18px) tone='secondary'> : null}.

Label (L48-50): web {label && <span text-[10px] text-[var(--text-muted)] uppercase tracking-wider>} -> {label ? <AppText style={styles.label}(10px, letterSpacing 0.6, textTransform uppercase) tone='muted'> : null}.
Subtitle (L52): web {subtitle && <span text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)]>} -> {subtitle ? <AppText style={styles.subtitle}(12px) tone='secondary' variant='caption'> : null}.

Badge (L54-58): web {badge && <Badge variant={badgeVariantMap[badge.variant]} size='sm'>{badge.text}</Badge>} -> {badge ? <Badge variant={badgeVariantMap[badge.variant]}>{badge.text}</Badge> : null}. The web size='sm' (px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium) is baked into the native Badge styles (paddingHorizontal 6, paddingVertical 2, fontSize 12, fontWeight '500', borderRadius 9999). Closing JSX + brace (L59-61) preserved.

Native AnimatedNumber/useReduceMotion/Badge/fmtNumber/safeNumber are inlined copies of the web semantics: fmtNumber mirrors @/lib/numberFormat (locale-aware, fixed min===max fraction digits, en-US fallback on bad locale); the count-up uses Date.now elapsed + requestAnimationFrame and cancels on unmount (no dangling timers under --detectOpenHandles); reduce-motion jumps to the final value. BADGE_PALETTE maps success/warning/danger/neutral to the successSurface/warningSurface/dangerSurface/surfaceRaised + matching foreground theme tokens.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output -- only React, RN primitives (View, StyleSheet, AccessibilityInfo, type StyleProp/TextStyle), the shared apps/native AppText, and the theme tokens. Verified from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) exit 0, `npm run lint -- --quiet` exit 0, and `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` green.
